methods.name: list
methods.doc: List the effective immutable command descriptors for one agent.

methods.name: execute
methods.doc: Parse and execute a known command without sending it to the model. A resolved command's lifecycle is logged: `command/run` is appended before the handler is invoked and `command/done` after settlement (a thrown or aborted handler settles as `kind: 'error'`). Both are direct log-only appends — no turn wraps them, and persistence drains them at ordinary checkpoints. Admission misses (syntax or unknown name) log nothing — they never entered a handler. A `command/run` append failure fails the execution loud; a `command/done` append failure on the handler-failure path is contained so the handler's own error stays the reported failure. Attachment admission is enforced here, not in the composer: attachments sent to a command that does not declare `input.attachments`, an absent attachment store, and an exceeded image limit each settle as an error result before the handler runs. Validation rejection starts no attachment writes; a storage failure can leave only unreachable content-addressed objects for deferred collection.

props.name: definitionId
props.doc: Stable plugin-owned identity; absent for definitions without identity-based client behavior.

props.name: name
props.doc: Lowercase command name without the leading slash.

props.name: description
props.doc: Human-readable summary used in discovery UI.

props.name: input
props.doc: Optional free-form input hint advertised to capable clients.

CommandDescriptor.doc: Handler-free immutable command view returned to UI adapters.

props.name: commandId
props.doc: Pairing id carried by this execution's lifecycle events.

CommandExecution.doc: One settled command execution: the handler's normalized result plus the lifecycle pairing id minted for its `command/run`/`command/done` records, so a dispatching surface can correlate the Remote acknowledgment with the flow node those events produce.

props.name: hint
props.doc: Placeholder shown before the user supplies free-form input.

props.name: attachments
props.doc: Whether composer attachments may accompany an invocation. Absent or false = the executor rejects an invocation carrying attachments and capable composers refuse the submission before dispatch. A declaring command's handler receives the admitted durable blocks and owns every further grammar decision, including rejecting sub-commands that cannot use them.

CommandInputDescriptor.doc: Immutable metadata for a command's optional unstructured input.

props.name: sourceEventSeq
props.doc: Earlier authoritative domain event that owns a richer presentation.

CommandResult.doc: Expected command outcome rendered directly by the dispatching UI.

props.name: mediaType
props.doc: Declared media type, verified against the decoded bytes during admission.

props.name: data
props.doc: Canonical base64 encoding of the image bytes.

props.name: name
props.doc: Optional display name; it is never interpreted as a path.

CommandSubmitAttachment.doc: One browser-submitted command attachment: encoded image input or a staged file receipt.

ImageMediaType.doc: Raster image formats accepted by the version-one attachment path.
